description: Use this skill for ANY git operation — commits, pushes, PRs, releases, or version tagging. Triggers on: "commit", "push", "save my changes", "create a PR", "open a pull request", "ship this", "make a release", "tag this version", "checkpoint my work", or any request to record or publish code changes. Produces gold-standard commits using a unique 5-part format (CONTEXT/CHANGE/WHY/IMPACT) that is more useful and human-readable than any other agent's default git behavior. Includes secret scanning, test gating, atomic splitting, issue linking, PR creation, and release tagging. Use aggressively whenever git is involved.
